note: Conceptual/practice lesson on documenting the Salesforce sharing model (OWD, role hierarchy, sharing rules, manual/Apex sharing, permission sets, field-level security) using an access-matrix format, illustrated with invented role scenarios. No screenshots used per this course's conceptual, no-screenshots policy. The sharing-model layer order described is well-established, already-public Salesforce platform behavior and not a newly asserted specific figure or limit.
